name: band controls panel OPEN on the SUB band (label.bandControls with its {band} token substituted, plus label.steps / label.pulses / label.offset / label.phase — the panel is display:none until an Expand button is clicked)
band controls panel OPEN on the MID band (the same five labels with the LONGEST French band name substituted into the heading — the SUB pass above would certify the shortest)
the SUB band switched to EUCLIDEAN (label.euclidean, the other face of the mode caption; label.manual is the resting face the default state already measured)

settings popover OPEN (label.language, label.hoverHelp and the ui.off face of the toggle are all inside a [hidden] panel, so the gate never measures them at rest). LAST but one on purpose: the popover's own dismiss handler closes it on a mousedown anywhere else, so opening it earlier would leave it shut by the time the toggle below is clicked.

hover help ON (the ui.on face of the settings toggle, which no resting state shows — the C++ default is off). A real click on the real control, inside the popover the previous state opened, so the dismiss handler leaves the panel up.
